title: Lake Tahoe: Stand Up Paddleboard Rental
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Free Parking: First come first served
Umbrellas and chairs are available for an extra fee at the beach tent
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Paddle at your own pace on beautiful Lake Tahoe! This self-guided experience features stand-up paddleboards available for half day or full day rentals. Launch directly from the sandy beach into the crystal-clear waters of Tahoe Vista, a beloved local spot for generations.

Each rental includes a paddle lesson, so you can feel confident and ready to explore the lake. Your safety is our priority, with complimentary life jackets and leashes provided. Onsite amenities include clean restrooms, shaded areas, and inviting picnic spots, making your visit comfortable and convenient. Parking is easy and hassle-free.

Relax, soak in the stunning surroundings, and immerse yourself in the laid-back Tahoe vacation vibe for an unforgettable day on the water.

Special Offer: Call our office to book two hours and enjoy the third hour on us!
